latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — convert YouTube videos or transcripts into SEO-optimised, formatted blog posts.

- Automatically fetches and rewrites YouTube video transcripts into ready-to-publish blog posts.
- Generates an SEO metadata block (title, meta description, keywords, URL slug).
- Analyses video content to extract primary/secondary keywords, content type, and target audience.
- Produces structured blog posts with headings, bullet points, and internal linking suggestions.
- Handles both auto-generated and manual captions, and provides clear error messages for unsupported inputs.
- Applies British English by default and adapts post length based on video duration.
